xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex70032026-10-1401-24-47" status="unreviewed">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3816">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">ar</rs></note> na re skyon med de sbyor bzhir byas pa'i tshe na rnam mkhyen yul yin la | chos sku 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir zhes smra ba la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> na re mkhyen gsum sbyor ba'i yul ma yin te sbyor ba'i yul gzhi lam rnam pa yin la | mkhyen gsum gzhi lam rnam pa gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir zer ba la <note type="editorial"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs></note> bden mod kyi slob lam mkhyen gsum gyis gzhi lam rnam pa skye med du rtogs te bsgom pa las mkhyen gsum rtogs pa rab tu 'gyur ba la mkhyen gsum sbyor ba'i yul yin par btags so zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | mkhyen gsum gzhi lam rnam pa yin te lam bden yin pa'i phyir dang | thar pa'i go skabs 'byed pa'i phyir dang | shes rnam pa yin pa'i phyir ro | </seg></TEI>
